prompt: Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Use Paper and Carmine: page #FFFFFF, text #202020, accent #AF173B, secondary surface #F0F2F2, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in EB Garamond and reading text in Work Sans; literary serif heading with restrained sans text. Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Use body 18px, heading 48px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
